summary: #IndieWeb went with very hard filters aimed at value aligned dev community while educators had to fight against the myth of digital native and take people online for the first time. The tech stack and people power now coalescing. Makes me proud and hopeful.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#IndieWeb went with very hard filters aimed at value aligned dev community while educators had to fight against the myth of digital native and take people online for the first time.

The tech stack and people power now coalescing. Makes me proud and hopeful.
